items.title: A check, not a show
items.body:
This is the week boss. You already met these blocks. You are proving you can name them.

- **Title, Text, Image, Teaser, Container**
- **Experience Fragment** as a layout strip, not a DITA reuse
- One **workflow** (a named path to ask for publish) or **Quick Publish** if that is the path your desk uses

Fail the quiz and **week 11 stays locked**. Retry as many times as you want. The 5-minute warmup does not open the week.

You may not have AEM. The evidence is the field log, the labeled mock, and the official video. That is enough.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Workflow** :  a named path that asks for publish. Quick Publish is the short path. Some desks want the longer named path. Write the one you would click.

blocks.title: AEM from Headful to Headless (Adobe for Business)

lessons.title: Landing skeleton plus a ship path

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Skeleton missing a block you claimed, or the ship path is unnamed, or mixed names remain, or mocks have no caption.

Expected: Skeleton plus a workflow name or Quick Publish. Names clean. Mock labeled.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Gather field-log-63 through 68. Add field-log-69.txt: Kitepump landing skeleton (Title, Image with alt, Text, Container of Teasers, optional Experience Fragment promo). Two ‘will not’ lines (no handbook paste, no nested-box hobby).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Read a page-workflow topic on Experience League (request activation, or the path your docs show). Write the name and who starts it. If your desk uses only Quick Publish, write that.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: A **workflow** is a named path that asks someone (or the system) to publish. Quick Publish is the short path you met last week. Name the one you would actually click.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Check the week10 folder: no sentence that calls an Experience Fragment a conref. No sentence that calls Page Editor ‘Author mode’.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Labeled mock: the landing skeleton. Caption: mock.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Pass the quiz. Week 11 stays locked until this day is finished (lab + quiz + a short note).

blocks.summary: Skeleton plus a workflow name or Quick Publish. Names clean. Mock labeled.

blocks.q: You failed this check. Does week 11 open anyway?
options: No. Finish this day’s lab, quiz, and note. You can retry the quiz.
Yes, if you do the 5-minute warmup
blocks.why: Next week waits until you can name the blocks and one way to ship. Retry is free.

blocks.q: The core-components-desk badge means you wrote the code behind Title and Text. True or not?
options: Not true :  you can name and use the blocks. Developers build them
blocks.why: This week is author work. You insert the blocks. You do not implement them.

blocks.q: You restore an old hero, then Quick Publish without looking. What can go wrong?
options: You may ship an old picture, or a picture that was never published
blocks.why: Restore is on author. Publish is a second step. Check the picture too.
